title: Gloves of Succour

sources.title: Gloves of Succour
markers: | description = The {{uncommon|Gloves of Succour}} are an uncommon pair of gloves that grant a creature healed by a [[Paladin|Paladin's]] [[Lay on Hands]] resistance against weapon attacks.

summary: The Early Access item granted +1 Strength saves and defensive support to a creature healed by Lay on Hands.

fields.Availability: Unobtainable in normal play. Early Access item replaced by Gloves of Heroism.
fields.Legacy effect: The item description says the target gains resistance to weapon attacks. The linked current Warding Hands page describes the replacement item’s Heroism effect.
fields.Base value: 350 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
